title: Setting reserved concurrency fails with decreases account's UnreservedConcurrentExecution below its minimum value on a new AWS account
symptoms: InvalidParameterValueException: Specified ReservedConcurrentExecutions for function decreases account's UnreservedConcurrentExecution below its minimum value
CloudFormation, SAM, CDK, or Serverless deploy fails on the reservedConcurrency line
Service Quotas shows a concurrent executions value far below the documented 1,000
cause: New accounts start with a reduced Lambda concurrency quota that AWS raises over time with usage. Reserving concurrency for one function must leave a minimum unreserved pool, which a small quota cannot cover.
fix: Remove or lower reserved concurrency until the quota is raised, and request a Concurrent executions increase in Service Quotas.
apply:
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code lambda --quota-code L-B99A9384
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code lambda --quota-code L-B99A9384 --desired-value 1000
affected: New AWS accounts with the reduced default Lambda concurrency quota; any Region
